question: Who took over as the Chief of Army Staff on April 30, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Manoj Pande.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• The government has approved the proposal for the appointment of Eastern Army Commander Lieutenant General Manoj Pande as the next Chief of Army Staff.
 
• Lieutenant General Manoj Pande took charge as the 29th Chief of the Army Staff
 
• General Pande succeeds to Gen Manoj Mukund Naravane who superannuated on April 30, 2022.
 
• Before being appointed as the Chief of Army Staff, Lt Gen Manoj Pande was serving as the Vice Chief of the Army Staff. 
 
 
• Lt Gen BS Raju has taken the charge as the Vice Chief of Army Staff on May 1, 2022.
 
 
 
• He was earlier the Director-General at Army Headquarters.
 
• He has taken an active part in Operation Vijay and Operation Parakram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• Important current affairs of 2021-22 related to the Indian Army.

 
 
• The 8th edition of the Indian Army Chief’s Conclave, a gathering of serving and former Chiefs of Army Staff of the Indian Army, was organised at New Delhi from September 16-18.
 
• Indian Air Force (IAF) has deployed the first squadron of Russian to make the S-400 air defence missile system in the western Punjab sector in December 2021.
 
• Indian Army Day is celebrated on 15 January every year in India, in recognition of Field Marshal Kodandera M. Cariappa's taking over as the first Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Army.
 
• Army Chief General M.M. Naravane has assumed the charge as the Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee that comprises the three service chiefs in December 2021.
 
• The Indian Army won the gold medal at the prestigious Cambrian Patrol Exercise which was held in the United Kingdom.
 
• Nepal Army Chief Gen Prabhu Ram Sharma was conferred with the honorary rank of ‘General of the Indian Army’ by President Ram Nath Kovind in November 2021.
 
• The Indian Army celebrates October 27 every year as ‘Infantry Day'.
 
• In 2021, the nation celebrated its 75th Infantry Day on October 27, 2021.
